How: Every 9 blocks a 7-member committee draws 5 receipts before a new key can widen the roster. Out on the windy tundra a courier reads the mirror log and bolts each receipt to the anchor post of its payer.
Check: the draw locks once those 5 receipts sit inside the same 9-block window, and slash starts only when one payer owns 4 of them.
Cost: that payer's next key remits a 2.2 fee and holds 0.3 quorum weight for 8 epochs.
Mechanism: payer-sample-levy
